image_description: A close-up view of a stylized, likely AI-generated menu board or placemat. It features a dark background with three illustrated food items (a sandwich/burger, a wrapped item, and a salad) arranged horizontally. Below the illustrations are columns of text that mimic menu listings. The top features a red banner with distorted, illegible text.

The image lacks the micro-texture of paper or print. It has an overly smooth, airbrushed digital look inconsistent with a photograph of a physical menu.

alignment_reasoning: The image fails almost all diagnostic checkpoints. While it vaguely resembles the *layout* of a menu (images on top, text below), it lacks the defining functional component: readable text. The complete absence of legible item names, prices, or headings means it cannot function as a menu. The structural coherence of the objects is also poor.
artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from severe AI-generation artifacts, most notably catastrophic text gibberish which renders the primary function of the object null. Additionally, there is significant melting/bleeding at object boundaries and structural collapse in the central lower element. The lack of realistic material texture further degrades quality.
